Definition: from G53; cleanliness (the quality), i.e. (specially) chastity:--purity.
BiblicalUsage: hagneía means purity. In 1 Timothy 4:12, the text says "in purity."
TheologicalSignificance: I read hagneía plainly — it means purity, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
